window context: 17:36 6058389 live capture complete; 18:13 d9c8f1e dashboard fix; 19:04 78479a8; 19:32 1ca40c8 Nyquist validation; 20:28 daf8f4e INT-NONCE-SELL. The 40 opens fall inside this development window

sibling_sites_checked: All five tables (trades, exit_state, pause_state, chain_state, lp_baseline) in both in-memory images (A_merged_2025 = WAL-recovered 20:25 state, B_checkpoint_1733 = main-file-only 17:33 state), keyed by schema-confirmed primary keys (trades.id, exit_state.trade_id, pause_state.id, chain_state.chain, lp_baseline.trade_id). token, tx_hash and pair_or_pool_address compared against 150 hex literals from 146 test files at the audit base (99 synthetic, 12 public-historical, 39 production-constant). Every one of the 40 WAL commit points replayed. Raw bytes of the main file and the WAL scanned for leftover hex values. sqlite_sequence read in both images. Writers at the base SHA: src/utils/db.ts import-time open, pragmas, migrateSchema (user_version :232), migrateJsonState :315 (no-op when trades exist) and normalizeLegacyMainnetRows :316 (writes only legacy mainnet rows; none present).
severity_rationale: S2 / EXPOSURE: the test-to-live-DB trust boundary was crossed in practice (40 opens of the live DB wrote its header between 17:33 and 20:25), but the realized effect stops at the file header: no row in trades, exit_state, pause_state, chain_state or lp_baseline changed at any commit point, so dedup, exit resume and the kill-switch were not affected. The mechanism itself (tests open and migrate the live DB at import) is graded S1 in AUD-RAIL-002. The only literal-matched rows are the LADYS token and pair, public-historical and consistent with the Phase 21 live capture, so they are not attributed to tests. No row is attributed-test-write or literal-match-uncorroborated, so the tag test-origin-db-row is not set and the status stays candidate. Open items: the deleted trade id 1 (before 17:33, origin unknown) and which program made the 40 opens.
recommendation: Leave the live data/ files untouched (P3). The forensic result gives no reason to clean anything: no test-written row was found, and the two LADYS trades look like the real Phase 21 live capture. The SAFE-02 rails (22-05, 22-07..22-10: DB tripwire under Vitest, per-worker temp DB, no real .env) stop new test opens of the live DB, and the SAFE-04 process lock covers a second bot. Any later decision about the deleted trade id 1 or a cleanup is an operator decision for a later phase; nothing is fixed in Phase 22 (NAC-13).
